status: Accepted trace-proof replacement; publication derivative prepared locally.
scope: Nonreal tau, every integer A>=1, same necessary annulus with strict lower and inclusive upper endpoint; no new Rogers–Szegő family coverage.
exact_controls: Parity determinant and derivative identities at A=1,...,32; A=3 and A=4 equality examples and their conjugates, with integer and rational arithmetic.
proof_basis: Arbitrary-index Hermite parity recurrence, endpoint nonvanishing, characteristic-polynomial trace with algebraic multiplicities, signed imaginary-part identity and separate zero-root guards.
attribution_status: Bounded comparison; primary Sawa–Uchida, Arlinskiĭ–Tsekanovskiĭ, Grosu–Grosu and DLMF passages checked; Carlitz original unread; historical priority unresolved.
limitations: Finite checks corroborate the proof rather than establish its all-A scope. No new family, FFT-speed, worldwide novelty, conditioning or universal good-prime claim.
publication_kind: Privacy-filtered proof and source-comparison derivatives; original reports unchanged.
